title: Head of Startups, Developer GTM
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: SF Bay Area About Cloudflare At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before. About the Team The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement. We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build. The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. About the Role Startups are where the next great companies, and the next great Cloudflare accounts, are born. The builders choosing their infrastructure stack today at seed and Series A will be running production workloads at massive scale in three to five years. We need a leader who has lived that journey firsthand. We are hiring a Head of Startups to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for the startup segment. Unlike traditional programs-operations roles, which are managed by our dedicated Startup Programs team, this role acts as the strategic GTM leader who sets the vision for how Cloudflare wins with startups, builds deep relationships across the VC and accelerator ecosystem, and drives the commercial trajectory from first developer sign-up through expansion and committed spend. You will combine your ecosystem fluency with rigorous GTM execution to build repeatable motions, enable the field, and translate startup signals into actionable recommendations for Product and Pricing. We are looking for someone who has been in the founder's seat. A former CRO or co-founder who has raised venture capital, navigated board dynamics, and understands what startup CTOs and CEOs actually care about when choosing infrastructure. You bring instant credibility with founders and VCs because you have been one. You combine that ecosystem fluency with the GTM rigor to build repeatable motions, enable the field, and translate startup signals into actionable recommendations for Product and Pricing. What You Will Do Define and own the startups GTM strategy. Build the operating model for how Cloudflare acquires, activates, and grows startup accounts, from early-stage free-tier adoption through expansion into committed spend. Set goals, scorecards, and cadences for the segment. Build and leverage ecosystem relationships. Develop deep, trust-based relationships with venture capital firms, accelerators, and incubators. Make Cloudflare the default infrastructure recommendation when VCs advise portfolio companies on their stack. Lead executive engagement with founders and CTOs. Be the face of Cloudflare's Developer Platform to the startup community. Engage directly with startup founders, CTOs, and heads of engineering to understand their workloads and guide them onto Cloudflare. Drive activation, expansion, and commercial structure. Use usage telemetry to identify high-potential startups, find next-best actions and expansion paths, and work with the account team, Deal Desk, and Pricing to structure startup-appropriate commercial agreements as companies grow. Lead Cross-Functional Startup Initiatives. Partner closely with Startup Programs, Marketing, and BDR teams to ensure credits, onboarding, campaigns, and event presence are fully aligned with the broader GTM strategy and conversion funnel. Enable the field on startup motions. Ship playbooks, talk tracks, deal patterns, and objection handling tailored to start
